result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there is one clear visual defect: a loading spinner is stuck on top of the already-loaded Tokumaru Ramen Bar image. A few other elements appear awkwardly clipped at screen edges, though some clipping may be intentional carousel behavior.

issues.description: A loading spinner is displayed in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card even though the image behind it has fully rendered, making the card look stuck in a loading state.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the loading indicator is dismissed once the image finishes loading (hide the spinner on the image onLoad event), or remove the spinner overlay if the image is already cached.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' is cut off at the screen edge with its name truncated ('Trattoria Piccol...') without an ellipsis or clear affordance, and the card image bleeds off-screen abruptly.
issues.suggestion: Add proper text truncation with an ellipsis and consistent peeking width for carousel items so partially visible cards clearly signal horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: The last category chip after 'Healthy' is clipped at the right edge showing only a sliver of an empty pill, which looks broken rather than like a scroll hint.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing or peek amount so the partially visible chip shows some of its label, making it obvious it's a scrollable filter row.

issues.description: The pizza card at the bottom ('–20%') is cut off by the bottom navigation bar mid-image, hiding its title, rating, and delivery info.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/inset to the scroll container so content isn't obscured by the fixed bottom navigation, or ensure this is only a scroll-position artifact and content is reachable.
